name: le-yard-ops-reporting
description: Source-aware operating briefs and exception reporting for Le Yard OS.

interface.shortDescription: Turn OS evidence into trusted briefs
interface.longDescription: Builds manager and owner reports from scoped Le Yard OS evidence while preserving location, date, freshness, truncation, permissions, and the boundary between connected records and synthetic demonstrations.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a verified weekly operations brief from these OS exports.
Explain the largest operating exceptions without filling data gaps.
Check this report for source, scope, freshness, and truncation risks.
